meaning.en: the great sage Ribhu
practised austerity for twelve years by the reckoning of the gods
meaning.hi: देवताओं की गणना से बारह वर्ष तपस्या की

meaning.en: the Lord in the form of a boar appeared
rise, rise, choose a boon
whatever is desired by those full of desire
I do not ask for even in a dream
they say freedom comes from knowing your form
meaning.hi: कहते हैं आपके स्वरूप के ज्ञान से मुक्ति मिलती है

meaning.en: teach the knowledge of the highest reality
twenty-four principles
thirty-six, and ninety-six
I will explain their order
listen with an attentive mind
the organs of perception are five
the ear, the skin, the eye and so on
the organs of action are five
speech, hands, feet and so on, in order
meaning.hi: वाणी, हाथ, पैर आदि क्रम से

meaning.en: the vital breaths, beginning with prana, are five
likewise the five objects beginning with sound
meaning.hi: इसी तरह शब्द आदि पाँच विषय

meaning.en: the mind
the intellect
the sense of 'I'
and memory: these four
these are the twenty-four principles
the knowers of the highest reality know
together with these principles
and the five elements in their compounded form
earth, water, and fire
air, and space
the three bodies
gross, subtle and causal
the wise know
and the three states
waking, dream and deep sleep
adding together
thirty-six kinds of principles
the sages know
together with the principles described before
meaning.hi: पहले कहे गए तत्त्वों के साथ

meaning.en: one should combine the principles
and there are the six modifications of being
it is born
and it grows
transformation, decline, destruction
they know these as the six transformations
hunger and thirst
grief and confusion
old age and death
these are called the six waves
meaning.hi: ये छह ऊर्मियाँ कही गई हैं

meaning.en: now I tell you the six sheaths
meaning.hi: अब तुम्हें छह कोश बताता हूँ

meaning.en: skin, blood, flesh, fat
marrow and bone: understand these
craving and anger
greed and delusion
arrogance and envy too
these are the six enemies

words.sanskrit: vishvah cha taijasah prajnah eva cha

meaning.en: the waker, the dreamer and the deep sleeper
the threefold individual self
clarity, restlessness and dullness
the three qualities
action already begun to bear fruit
action being stored for the future
action accumulated from the past
this is called the threefold action
meaning.hi: यह तीन प्रकार का कर्म कहा गया

words.sanskrit: vachana adana gamana visarga ananda panchakam

meaning.en: the five: speaking, taking, walking, releasing and enjoying
meaning.hi: बोलना, लेना, चलना, त्यागना और आनन्द, ये पाँच

meaning.en: forming intentions (the mind's function)
and deciding (the intellect's function)
claiming as one's own (the ego's function)
holding firmly in mind (the function of attention)

words.sanskrit: mudita karuna maitri upeksha cha chatushtayam

meaning.en: gladness, compassion, friendliness and equanimity: these four
meaning.hi: प्रसन्नता, करुणा, मैत्री और उपेक्षा, ये चार

meaning.en: the directions, wind, sun and the lord of waters
the twin Ashvins, fire, Indra, Vishnu and Death
meaning.hi: अश्विनी, अग्नि, इन्द्र, उपेन्द्र और मृत्यु

meaning.en: likewise the moon and the four-faced Brahma
meaning.hi: वैसे ही चन्द्रमा और चतुर्मुख ब्रह्मा

meaning.en: Rudra, the knower of the field, and the Lord
adding the kinds of principles together
ninety-six have been declared
from the principles described before
what is entirely different
free of affliction
me in the form of a boar
those who worship with devotion to me
meaning.hi: जो मुझमें भक्ति से भजते हैं

meaning.en: freed from ignorance and its effects
meaning.hi: अज्ञान और उसके कार्यों से मुक्त

meaning.en: they become liberated while living
those who know the ninety-six principles
meaning.hi: जो छियानवे तत्त्वों को जानते हैं

meaning.en: engaged in whatever stage of life
meaning.hi: किसी भी आश्रम में लगे हुए

meaning.en: with matted hair, shaven head, or a tuft
is freed; of this there is no doubt
meaning.hi: मुक्त हो जाता है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: the great yogi named Ribhu
the Lord of Lakshmi in boar form
the highest knowledge of reality
Lord, teach it to me
asked thus, the Lord spoke
meaning.hi: इस तरह पूछे जाने पर भगवान बोले

meaning.en: who breaks the sorrows of devotees
by the duties of one's own station and stage of life
meaning.hi: अपने वर्ण और आश्रम के धर्म से

meaning.en: by disciplined effort
by pleasing the teacher
the means arises in people
meaning.hi: मनुष्यों में साधन उत्पन्न होता है

meaning.en: the four beginning with dispassion
and discrimination between the lasting and the passing
dispassion towards rewards here and hereafter
meaning.hi: इस लोक और परलोक के प्रति वैराग्य

meaning.en: the six treasures beginning with calmness
the longing for freedom
one should practise that
having thus gained control of the senses
giving up the thought 'mine' towards everything
meaning.hi: हर चीज़ के प्रति ममता-बुद्धि छोड़कर

meaning.en: in me, the witnessing awareness
one should place the sense of 'I'
having obtained the rare human birth
and within that, a human body
and fitness for sacred study
through hearing the deepest teachings of the great Vishnu and so on
the nature beyond all station and stage of life
meaning.hi: वर्ण और आश्रम से परे स्वरूप

meaning.en: of the character of being, awareness and joy
one who does not know it is ignorant
meaning.hi: जो नहीं जानता वह अज्ञानी है

meaning.en: when will he be free?
I alone am happiness, nothing else
meaning.hi: मैं ही सुख हूँ, दूसरा नहीं

words.sanskrit: anyat chet na eva tat sukham

meaning.en: if there is another, that is not happiness at all
meaning.hi: यदि कुछ और है तो वह सुख नहीं है

meaning.en: nothing is dear except for my sake
meaning.hi: मेरे लिए ही सब प्रिय है, अन्यथा नहीं

meaning.en: I am not dear for another's sake; I am dear in myself
meaning.hi: मैं किसी और के लिए नहीं, स्वयं प्रिय हूँ

meaning.en: as the object of the highest love
meaning.hi: परम प्रेम के आश्रय रूप में

meaning.en: may I never cease to be
meaning.hi: मैं कभी न होना बन्द करूँ

meaning.en: 'may I always be'
the one who sees thus, the seer
that I am, Vishnu, O lord of sages
meaning.hi: वह मैं विष्णु हूँ, हे मुनीश्वर

meaning.en: the statement 'I am not luminous'
which is itself bound up with luminosity alone
meaning.hi: जो प्रकाश से ही बँधा है

meaning.en: that self-luminous self
how could non-luminosity touch it?
self-shining and resting on nothing
those who know with full certainty
meaning.hi: जो पूरी निश्चितता से जानते हैं

meaning.en: they indeed possess real understanding
meaning.hi: वे ही विज्ञान से सम्पन्न हैं

meaning.en: this is my firm conviction
apart from the self, full in itself

words.sanskrit: jagat jiva ishvara adayah na santi

meaning.en: world, individual soul, ruling God and the like do not exist
meaning.hi: संसार, जीव, ईश्वर आदि नहीं हैं

meaning.en: nor is there illusion
and I am entirely other than these
of the nature of blinding darkness, ignorance
meaning.hi: अन्धे अँधेरे के रूप वाला अज्ञान

meaning.en: marked by things like action and duty
the self that shines by its own light
cannot touch me at all
meaning.hi: मुझे छूने योग्य ही नहीं है

meaning.en: the self as witness of everything
free of all station and stage of life
seeing it as of the nature of the highest reality
becomes the highest reality itself
meaning.hi: स्वयं ब्रह्म ही हो जाता है

meaning.en: all this that appears
meaning.hi: यह सब जो प्रकाशित हो रहा है

meaning.en: the highest state, whose form is knowing
seeing it through the measure of the Upanishads
meaning.hi: वेदान्त के मान से देखता हुआ

meaning.en: is freed that very instant
meaning.hi: तत्काल ही मुक्त हो जाता है

meaning.en: a knowledge like the knowledge 'I am the body'
meaning.hi: 'मैं देह हूँ' के ज्ञान जैसा ज्ञान

meaning.en: which removes the notion 'I am the body'
meaning.hi: जो देहात्म-बुद्धि को बाधित करता है

meaning.en: in whom it arises within the self
meaning.hi: जिसके आत्मा में ही उत्पन्न हो

meaning.en: he is freed even without wishing
meaning.hi: वह न चाहते हुए भी मुक्त होता है

meaning.en: marked by fullness of truth, knowledge and joy
meaning.hi: सत्य, ज्ञान और आनन्द की पूर्णता के लक्षण वाला

meaning.en: beyond darkness
constantly seeing the bliss of the highest reality
how could he be bound by action?
the witness of the three states
marked by truth, knowledge, joy and so on
meaning.hi: सत्य, ज्ञान, आनन्द आदि लक्षणों वाला

meaning.en: the ultimate meaning pointed to by the words 'you' and 'I'
untouched by every flaw
present everywhere
the self made of being and awareness
the eye of knowledge beholds
the eye of ignorance does not see
like a blind man the shining sun
that highest reality is pure knowing itself
marked by truth and understanding
meaning.hi: सत्य और प्रज्ञा जिसके लक्षण हैं

meaning.en: simply by fully knowing the highest reality thus
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार ब्रह्म को पूर्णतः जानने से ही

meaning.en: a mortal becomes immortal
that highest reality, joyful and beyond opposites
without qualities, solid with truth and awareness
meaning.hi: निर्गुण, सत्य और चित् से घना

meaning.en: having known it as the form of one's own self
meaning.hi: उसे अपनी आत्मा का रूप जानकर

meaning.en: is not afraid of anything at all
pure awareness, everywhere, eternal
entirely whole, happiness, without a second

words.sanskrit: sakshat brahma eva na anyah asti

meaning.en: directly the highest reality alone; there is nothing else
meaning.hi: साक्षात् ब्रह्म ही है, अन्य कुछ नहीं

meaning.en: such is the settled state of the knowers of that reality
for the one who does not know, a flood of sorrows
meaning.hi: अज्ञानी के लिए दुःखों की बाढ़

meaning.en: for the knower, the world is full of joy
for the blind the world is dark
but bright for those with good eyes
meaning.hi: पर अच्छी आँखों वालों के लिए प्रकाशमय

meaning.en: in the endless being, awareness and joy
in me who bears the form of the boar
when established, there is only oneness
meaning.hi: स्थित होने पर अद्वैत भाव होता है

meaning.en: what is bondage, and who is freed?
meaning.hi: बन्धन क्या और मुक्त कौन होता है?

meaning.en: one's own nature is pure awareness
meaning.hi: अपना स्वरूप तो केवल चेतना है

meaning.en: always, for all embodied beings
not at all the bundle of body and the rest
meaning.hi: देह आदि का संघात बिल्कुल नहीं

meaning.en: an object of sight, like a pot
meaning.hi: घड़े की तरह दृष्टि का विषय

meaning.en: shining as if other than one's own self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा से मानो भिन्न प्रतीत होता

meaning.en: this world of moving and unmoving things
understanding it as nothing but one's self
dwell on the thought 'I am that'
one's own nature enjoys itself
meaning.hi: अपना स्वरूप स्वयं को ही भोगता है

meaning.en: there is nothing to enjoy apart from oneself
meaning.hi: अपने से अलग कोई भोज्य नहीं

meaning.en: if it exists, its form is existence
meaning.hi: यदि है, तो उसका रूप अस्तिता है

meaning.en: that is the highest reality, marked by being
meaning.hi: वह अस्तित्व-लक्षण वाला ब्रह्म ही है

meaning.en: one rich in the knowledge of the highest reality
the whole world that appears
even while always seeing
never sees it as separate from their own self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा से अलग नहीं देखता

meaning.en: from fully knowing my true nature
meaning.hi: मेरे स्वरूप को पूर्णतः जानने से

meaning.en: that person is not bound by actions
free of body, senses and the rest
the witness of all
the single knowledge of the ultimately real
whose self is happiness, shining by itself
knows everything as one's own nature
meaning.hi: सब को अपने स्वरूप के रूप में जानता है

meaning.en: who, by their own experience
that one is the steady sage and is to be recognised
meaning.hi: वह धीर है, उसे ही जानना चाहिए

meaning.en: that one is I; Ribhu, become that reality
meaning.hi: वह मैं हूँ; ऋभु, तुम वह तत्त्व बनो

meaning.en: the experience of the world is not constant
meaning.hi: संसार का अनुभव सदा नहीं रहता

meaning.en: the experience of knowing one's nature is indeed constant
meaning.hi: स्वरूप-बोध का अनुभव निश्चय ही सदा है

meaning.en: seeing this, the one of complete understanding
meaning.hi: यह देखता हुआ पूर्ण ज्ञान वाला

words.sanskrit: na bandha muktah na cha baddhah

meaning.en: is neither freed from bondage nor bound
meaning.hi: न बन्धन से मुक्त है, न बँधा हुआ

meaning.en: by keeping attention on one's own nature
the witness of all, who dances
whoever thinks of me even for a moment
meaning.hi: जो मुहूर्त भर मेरा चिन्तन करे

meaning.en: is released from all bonds
meaning.hi: सब बन्धनों से छूट जाता है

meaning.en: to the one dwelling within all beings
meaning.hi: सब प्राणियों के भीतर स्थित को

meaning.en: to the ever-free self of awareness
to the one whose form is inner consciousness
to me alone, salutation upon salutation
you, blessed Lord, are truly I
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्, आप ही मैं हूँ

meaning.en: O God, I am truly you
meaning.hi: हे देव, मैं ही आप हूँ

meaning.en: to you and to me, the endless one
to me and to you, the self of awareness
meaning.hi: मुझे, आपको, उस चेतन आत्मा को

meaning.en: salutation to me, the supreme Lord
and salutation to you, the auspicious one
what shall I do, where shall I go?
what shall I take up, what shall I give up?
since the universe is filled by me
as by the waters of the great deluge

words.sanskrit: antah sangam bahih sangam atma sangam cha

meaning.en: inner attachment, outer attachment and attachment to the body
meaning.hi: भीतरी संग, बाहरी संग और देह का संग

meaning.en: one whose self has turned back from every attachment
meaning.hi: सब संगों से निवृत्त आत्मा वाला

meaning.en: comes to me, without doubt
meaning.hi: वह मुझे पाता है, सन्देह नहीं

words.sanskrit: ahim iva jana yogam sarvada varjayet

meaning.en: always shuns the company of people as one shuns a snake
meaning.hi: साँप की तरह जनसंग से सदा बचता है

meaning.en: the dispassionate one who would give up a lovely woman like a corpse
meaning.hi: वैरागी जो सुन्दर स्त्री को शव की तरह त्यागना चाहे

words.sanskrit: visham iva vishaya adin manyamanah durantan

meaning.en: regarding sense objects as poison, bad in their end
meaning.hi: विषयों को दुःखान्त विष मानता हुआ

meaning.en: such a supreme swan in the world is Vasudeva; he is I myself
meaning.hi: संसार में वह परमहंस वासुदेव है, मैं ही हूँ

meaning.en: this is true, this is true
meaning.hi: यह सत्य है, यह सत्य है

meaning.en: this is declared here as the truth
meaning.hi: यहाँ यही सत्य कहा जाता है

meaning.en: I am the truth, the supreme reality
nothing whatever exists apart from me
meaning.hi: मुझसे अलग कुछ भी नहीं है

meaning.en: upa means near; the dwelling near
meaning.hi: उप यानी समीप, जो निवास है

meaning.en: of the individual self and the supreme self
that is to be understood as fasting
not the drying up of the body
by the mere wasting of the body
what is gained there by the undiscerning?
meaning.hi: अविवेकियों को वहाँ क्या मिलता है?

meaning.en: just by beating the anthill
is the great serpent killed?
meaning.hi: क्या बड़ा साँप मर जाता है?

meaning.en: if one knows 'the highest reality exists'
that is only indirect knowledge
if one knows 'I am the highest reality'
meaning.hi: यदि जानता है कि 'मैं ब्रह्म हूँ'

meaning.en: that is called direct realisation
at whatever time one's own self
the yogi knows as it is, alone
meaning.hi: योगी केवल रूप में जानता है

meaning.en: beginning from that very time
that person becomes free while living
the settled conviction 'I am the highest reality'
is the cause of freedom for great souls
meaning.hi: महात्माओं की मुक्ति का कारण है

meaning.en: two words decide bondage and freedom
meaning.hi: बन्धन और मोक्ष के लिए दो पद

meaning.en: 'not mine' and 'mine'
a creature is bound by 'mine'
and freed by 'not mine'

words.sanskrit: bahya chinta na kartavya tatha eva antara chintika

meaning.en: do not dwell on outer worries, nor on inner ones
meaning.hi: न बाहरी चिन्ता करनी चाहिए, न भीतरी

words.sanskrit: sarva chintam samutsrijya svasthah bhava sada ribho

meaning.en: letting go of all worry, always rest in yourself, Ribhu
meaning.hi: सब चिन्ता छोड़कर, ऋभु, सदा स्वस्थ रहो

meaning.en: the whole world arises from the mere working of mental picturing
meaning.hi: केवल संकल्प की क्रिया से समस्त जगत

words.sanskrit: sankalpa matra kalane hi jagat vilasah

meaning.en: the world's display lies only in that picturing
meaning.hi: संसार का विलास संकल्प में ही है

meaning.en: give up this mere picturing

words.sanskrit: nirvikalpam ashritya mamakam padam hridi bhavayasva

meaning.en: resting in the thought-free, dwell in your heart on my state
meaning.hi: निर्विकल्प का आश्रय लेकर हृदय में मेरे पद का ध्यान करो

meaning.en: thinking of me, speaking of me
talking of me with one another
making me your one highest aim
pass your time, wise one

words.sanskrit: chit iha asti iti chinmatram idam

meaning.en: awareness is here; this is only awareness
meaning.hi: यहाँ चित् है; यह केवल चित् है

meaning.en: and it is made of awareness
you are awareness, I am awareness
meaning.hi: तुम चित् हो, मैं चित् हूँ

words.sanskrit: ete cha lokah chit iti bhavaya

meaning.en: cultivate the sense that these worlds too are awareness
meaning.hi: ये लोक भी चित् हैं, ऐसी भावना करो

meaning.en: leading passion to passionlessness
meaning.hi: राग को नीरागता तक ले जाकर

meaning.en: be unstained always
the doer and other factors of action born of ignorance
meaning.hi: अज्ञान से उत्पन्न कर्ता आदि कारक

meaning.en: by the action produced from them
the lamp of self-knowledge born of scripture
meaning.hi: श्रुति से उत्पन्न आत्मज्ञान का दीपक

meaning.en: how can it be obstructed?
setting aside what is not the self
unchanging while the world continues
with single-minded devotion
be devoted to the pure awareness within
meaning.hi: भीतर स्थित केवल चेतना में तत्पर रहो

meaning.en: the space in a pot and the space in a hall
are both established in the great space
so, in me, the space of awareness
the individual and the Lord are imagined
and the illusion that seems prior to the self
meaning.hi: और जो माया आत्मा से पहले लगती है

meaning.en: and at the end is set aside
meaning.hi: और अन्त में तिरस्कृत हो जाती है

meaning.en: declared by those who speak of the highest reality
as illusion, through careful discrimination
when illusion and its effects dissolve
meaning.hi: माया और उसके कार्य के विलय पर

meaning.en: there is neither lordship nor individual soul
so I am pure awareness alone
meaning.hi: इसलिए मैं शुद्ध चेतना ही हूँ

meaning.en: like the sky, free of limiting conditions
in the form of individual, Lord and the rest
meaning.hi: जीव, ईश्वर आदि के रूप में

meaning.en: consisting of the conscious and the non-conscious
creation, from the first gaze to the entering
meaning.hi: ईक्षण से प्रवेश तक की सृष्टि

meaning.en: is imagined by the Lord
worldly life, from waking up to release
meaning.hi: जाग्रत से मोक्ष तक का संसार

meaning.en: is imagined by the individual
from the Trinachiketa rite up to yoga
rest on the error about the Lord
from the materialists up to Sankhya
come to rest in the individual
so seekers of freedom should not set their minds
meaning.hi: इसलिए मुमुक्षुओं को मन नहीं लगाना चाहिए

meaning.en: on the doctrines of the individual and the Lord
meaning.hi: जीव और ईश के वादों में

meaning.en: but the truth of the highest reality
should be inquired into with an unwavering mind
meaning.hi: निश्चल मन से विचार करना चाहिए

meaning.en: the truth of the highest reality without a second
who do not know it as it truly is
all of them are simply deluded

words.sanskrit: kva muktih kva iha va sukham

meaning.en: where is freedom, or happiness here?
meaning.hi: मुक्ति कहाँ, या यहाँ सुख कहाँ?

meaning.en: if there is higher and lower status
among them, what of it?
with the kingship and begging of a dream
meaning.hi: सपने के राज्य और भिक्षा से

meaning.en: does one who has woken touch them?
meaning.hi: क्या जागा हुआ उन्हें छूता है?

meaning.en: when the intellect dissolves into ignorance
meaning.hi: अज्ञान में बुद्धि के विलय पर

meaning.en: the wise call that sleep
in me, where ignorance and its effects have dissolved
meaning.hi: मुझमें जहाँ अज्ञान और उसका कार्य विलीन हैं

meaning.en: how could there be sleep?
this full opening out of the intellect
is called waking
because of being free of change and the like
meaning.hi: विकार आदि से रहित होने के कारण

meaning.en: there is no waking for me
movement through the fine channels
of the intellect gives rise to dream
meaning.hi: बुद्धि का स्वप्न उत्पन्न करता है

meaning.en: in me, who have no nature of moving
there is no dream
at the time of deep sleep, when all has dissolved
meaning.hi: सुषुप्ति के समय जब सब विलीन हो

meaning.en: covered by darkness
enjoys its own nature, great joy
meaning.hi: अपने स्वरूप, महान आनन्द का भोग करता है

meaning.en: free of the world
everything, without distinction
who sees through the thread of awareness running through it
meaning.hi: जो चेतना के अन्वय से देखता है

meaning.en: that one alone is the direct knower
that one is Shiva, Hari and the Creator
meaning.hi: वह शिव है, वह हरि है, वह विधि है

meaning.en: this is a long dream
or a long confusion of the mind

words.sanskrit: dirgham va api manorajyam samsaram duhkha sagaram

meaning.en: or a long daydream: this worldly life, an ocean of sorrow
meaning.hi: या लम्बा मनोराज्य: यह संसार, दुःख का सागर

words.sanskrit: supteh utthaya supti antam brahma ekam pravichintyatam

meaning.en: from rising from sleep until sleep, let the one reality be contemplated
meaning.hi: नींद से उठकर सोने तक एक ब्रह्म का चिन्तन करो

meaning.en: by dissolving the world superimposed on the self
the mind is understood as being of my nature
meaning.hi: मन मेरे स्वरूप वाला समझा जाता है

meaning.en: having slain the group of six great enemies
meaning.hi: छह बड़े शत्रुओं के समूह को मारकर

meaning.en: like the mighty elephant, one stands alone without a second
meaning.hi: गन्धहस्ती की तरह अकेला, अद्वितीय हो जाता है

meaning.en: let the body set today
or last as long as the moon and stars
meaning.hi: या चन्द्रमा और तारों तक रहे

words.sanskrit: kah tavata api mama chit vapushah visheshah

meaning.en: what difference is that to me, whose body is awareness?
meaning.hi: मुझ चेतना-शरीरी के लिए उससे क्या अन्तर?

words.sanskrit: kumbha ambarasya na hi kah api vishesha leshah

meaning.en: the space in the pot has not the least trace of difference
meaning.hi: घड़े के आकाश में ज़रा भी अन्तर नहीं

meaning.en: the cast-off slough of a snake
devoid of life
lies fallen on the anthill
meaning.hi: बाँबी पर गिरी पड़ी रहती है

meaning.en: the snake does not regard it as its own

words.sanskrit: evam sthulam cha sukshmam cha shariram na abhimanyate

meaning.en: likewise does not identify with the gross and the subtle body
meaning.hi: इसी तरह स्थूल और सूक्ष्म शरीर को अपना नहीं मानता

meaning.en: when burnt by the fire of inner knowledge
meaning.hi: अन्तर्मुख ज्ञान की अग्नि से नष्ट होने पर

meaning.en: false knowledge together with its cause

words.sanskrit: neti neti iti rupatvat asharirah bhavati ayam

meaning.en: being of the nature 'not this, not this', he becomes bodiless
meaning.hi: 'नेति नेति' स्वरूप होने से वह अशरीरी हो जाता है

meaning.en: through scripture, the world is no longer taken as ultimately real
through direct seeing, one sees it as merely workable
meaning.hi: अपरोक्ष से उसे केवल कार्यक्षम देखता है

meaning.en: with the end of karma in motion, even its appearance ends
meaning.hi: प्रारब्ध के नाश से प्रतीति का नाश

words.sanskrit: evam tridha nashyati cha atma maya

meaning.en: thus the illusion clinging to the self is destroyed in three ways
meaning.hi: इस तरह आत्म-माया तीन प्रकार से नष्ट होती है

meaning.en: master, even when joined to the state of the highest reality
meaning.hi: स्वामी, ब्रह्मत्व से जुड़ जाने पर भी

meaning.en: the sense of being an individual does not go
when the truth of non-duality is awakened
meaning.hi: अद्वैत तत्त्व के बोध होने पर

meaning.en: the latent tendencies turn back
at the end of karma in motion, the body is lost
meaning.hi: प्रारब्ध के अन्त में देह का नाश

meaning.en: and illusion wears away entirely
meaning.hi: और माया पूरी तरह क्षीण हो जाती है

meaning.en: when it is said 'is', the whole world
is the highest reality whose essence is being
meaning.hi: सत्-रस वाला ब्रह्म ही होता है

meaning.en: when it is said 'shines', the whole world
its shining is the highest reality alone
meaning.hi: उसका भान केवल ब्रह्म ही है

words.sanskrit: marubhumau jalam sarvam marubhu matram eva tat

meaning.en: all the water in a desert is only desert
meaning.hi: मरुभूमि में सारा जल केवल मरुभूमि ही है

words.sanskrit: jagat trayam idam sarvam chinmatram sva vicharatah

meaning.en: this whole threefold world is only awareness, on inquiry into oneself
meaning.hi: यह सारा त्रिलोक स्वविचार से केवल चेतना है

words.sanskrit: ajnanam eva na kutah jagatah prasangah

meaning.en: there is no ignorance; how then any link to a world?
meaning.hi: अज्ञान ही नहीं, तो जगत का प्रसंग कहाँ?

words.sanskrit: jiva isha deshika vikalpa katha atidure

meaning.en: far beyond the tales of individual, Lord and teacher
meaning.hi: जीव, ईश, गुरु की विकल्प-कथा से बहुत दूर

words.sanskrit: ekanta kevala chit eka rasa svabhave

meaning.en: in the nature that is solely of the one taste of awareness
meaning.hi: केवल चेतना के एकरस स्वभाव में

words.sanskrit: brahma eva kevalam aham paripurnam asmi

meaning.en: I am the highest reality alone, completely full
when the moon of awareness is full-bodied
meaning.hi: जब बोध का चन्द्रमा पूर्ण आकार वाला हो

meaning.en: its own radiance stolen by the eclipse-demon of delusion
meaning.hi: मोह-राहु ने जिसका तेज चुरा लिया हो

meaning.en: rites such as bathing, giving and sacrifice
remain in vain until release
meaning.hi: मोचन तक व्यर्थ ही रहती हैं

meaning.en: as salt in water
becomes one through union
so the oneness of self and mind
meaning.hi: वैसे आत्मा और मन की एकता

meaning.en: is called samadhi
giving up sense objects is hard to attain
seeing reality is hard to attain
the natural state is hard to attain
without the compassion of a true teacher
of one in whom awakening to the inner power has arisen
meaning.hi: जिसमें शक्ति का बोध उत्पन्न हो चुका

meaning.en: who has given up all action without remainder
meaning.hi: जिसने सारे कर्म पूरी तरह छोड़ दिए

meaning.en: for such a yogi, the natural state
shines forth by itself
of quicksilver and of the mind
restlessness is by nature
when quicksilver is fixed and the mind is fixed
what is not accomplished on earth?
meaning.hi: धरती पर क्या सिद्ध नहीं होता?

meaning.en: when stilled, it removes disease
when killed, it gives life by itself
meaning.hi: मृत होकर स्वयं जीवन देता है

meaning.en: when bound, it grants movement through the sky
the highest reality lies in the quicksilver-like mind
meaning.hi: पारे जैसे मन में ब्रह्मत्व है

meaning.en: the mind is the master of the senses
the breath is the master of the mind
absorption is the master of the breath
take refuge in that master, absorption
meaning.hi: उस स्वामी लय का आश्रय लो

meaning.en: absorption without effort and without change
lives in yogis

words.sanskrit: uchchhinna sarva sankalpah nihshesha ashesha cheshtitah

meaning.en: every intention cut off, every striving ended
meaning.hi: सब संकल्प कटे हुए, सारी चेष्टा समाप्त

meaning.en: knowable only by oneself, beyond the reach of words
meaning.hi: केवल स्वयं जानने योग्य, वाणी से परे

words.sanskrit: punkha anupunkha vishaya ikshana tatparah api

meaning.en: though intent on seeing object after object in quick succession
meaning.hi: एक के बाद एक विषय देखने में लगा हुआ भी

words.sanskrit: brahma avalokana dhiyam na jahati yogi

meaning.en: the yogi does not let go of the mind that gazes on the highest reality
meaning.hi: योगी ब्रह्मदर्शी बुद्धि को नहीं छोड़ता

words.sanskrit: sangita tala laya vadya vasham gata api

meaning.en: even when carried away by song, beat, rhythm and instruments
meaning.hi: संगीत, ताल, लय और वाद्य के वश में होकर भी

words.sanskrit: mauli stha kumbha parirakshana dhih nati iva

meaning.en: like a dancer whose mind guards the pot on her head
meaning.hi: सिर पर रखे घड़े की रक्षा में मन रखने वाली नर्तकी की तरह

meaning.en: letting go of all concerns
with an alert mind
the inner sound alone should be attended to
meaning.hi: नाद का ही अनुसन्धान करना चाहिए

meaning.en: by one who desires the empire of yoga
there cannot be many natures
of a single thing, ever
therefore I am undivided
since there is nothing other than me
whatever is seen or heard
is not other than the highest reality

words.sanskrit: nitya shuddha vimukta ekam akhanda anandam advayam

meaning.en: ever pure, free, one, undivided joy, without a second
meaning.hi: नित्य शुद्ध, मुक्त, एक, अखण्ड आनन्द, अद्वय

words.sanskrit: satyam jnanam anantam yat param brahma aham eva tat

meaning.en: truth, knowledge, infinity: that supreme reality I am
meaning.hi: जो सत्य, ज्ञान, अनन्त परम ब्रह्म है, वह मैं ही हूँ

meaning.en: I am joy itself, undivided knowing

words.sanskrit: parat parah aham ghana chit prakashah

meaning.en: I am beyond the highest, a dense light of awareness

words.sanskrit: megha yatha vyoma na cha sprishanti

meaning.en: as clouds do not touch the sky
meaning.hi: जैसे बादल आकाश को नहीं छूते

meaning.en: the sorrows of worldly life do not touch me
meaning.hi: संसार के दुःख मुझे नहीं छूते

meaning.en: know all as happiness, through the destruction of sorrow
meaning.hi: दुःख के नाश से सब को सुख जानो

words.sanskrit: sarvam cha sat rupam asatya nashat

meaning.en: and all as being, through the destruction of the unreal
meaning.hi: असत्य के नाश से सब को सद्रूप

meaning.en: the form of awareness, endowed with shining
therefore this form of mine is undivided
meaning.hi: इसलिए मेरा यह रूप अखण्ड है

words.sanskrit: na hi janih maranam gamana agamau

meaning.en: no birth, death, going or coming
meaning.hi: न जन्म, न मरण, न जाना, न आना

words.sanskrit: na cha malam vimalam na cha vedanam

meaning.en: no impurity, no purity, no knowing
meaning.hi: न मल, न निर्मलता, न वेदन

meaning.en: all shines as made of awareness
meaning.hi: सब कुछ चिन्मय होकर चमकता है

meaning.en: ever more clearly, for the supreme yogi
meaning.hi: परम योगी के लिए और भी स्पष्ट

meaning.en: solid truth and awareness, undivided, without a second
free of all that is seen, free of sickness
that state, spotless, non-dual, auspicious
meaning.hi: जो पद निर्मल, अद्वय, शिव है

words.sanskrit: tat sada aham iti maunam ashraya

meaning.en: 'that I always am': thus take refuge in silence
meaning.hi: 'वह मैं सदा हूँ', ऐसा जानकर मौन का आश्रय लो

meaning.en: free of birth, death, pleasure and pain
meaning.hi: जन्म, मृत्यु, सुख, दुःख से रहित

meaning.en: far beyond caste, custom, family and clan
meaning.hi: जाति, नीति, कुल, गोत्र से दूर

meaning.en: the ground of this world, an apparent form of awareness
meaning.hi: चित् के विवर्त इस जगत का कारण

words.sanskrit: tat sada aham iti maunam ashraya

meaning.en: 'that I always am': thus take refuge in silence
meaning.hi: 'वह मैं सदा हूँ', ऐसा जानकर मौन का आश्रय लो

meaning.en: full, without a second, undivided awareness
free of reckoning the universe into differences
meaning.hi: विश्व के भेद की गणना आदि से रहित

meaning.en: the very substance of the one supreme consciousness

words.sanskrit: tat sada aham iti maunam ashraya

meaning.en: 'that I always am': thus take refuge in silence
meaning.hi: 'वह मैं सदा हूँ', ऐसा जानकर मौन का आश्रय लो

meaning.en: because it is not cancelled by anything
meaning.hi: किसी से भी बाधित न होने से

meaning.en: and is of one form in all three times
meaning.hi: तीनों कालों में एकरूप होने से

meaning.en: this existence is
my nature as being, always
that which is unconditioned and eternal
beyond all happiness, as in deep sleep
meaning.hi: नींद में सब सुखों से परे

meaning.en: this nature of happiness is
my nature as joy, always
by the rays of the sun, the darkness of night
meaning.hi: सूर्य की किरणों से रात का अँधेरा

meaning.en: however thick, is instantly destroyed
meaning.hi: बहुत घना होकर भी झट नष्ट हो जाता है

meaning.en: the denser darkness that causes worldly existence
meaning.hi: भव का कारण जो और घना अँधेरा है

words.sanskrit: hari dinakrit prabhaya na cha antarena

meaning.en: is not removed except by the light of Hari, the sun
meaning.hi: हरि रूपी सूर्य की प्रभा के बिना नहीं मिटता

meaning.en: by remembering my feet and by worship
meaning.hi: मेरे चरणों के स्मरण और पूजा से

meaning.en: a creature is freed from its own darkness
meaning.hi: प्राणी अपने अँधेरे से छूट जाता है

words.sanskrit: na hi marana prabhava pranasha hetuh

meaning.en: there is no cause that ends death and birth
meaning.hi: मृत्यु-जन्म के नाश का कोई कारण नहीं

words.sanskrit: mama charana smaranat rite asti kinchit

meaning.en: other than remembering my feet
just as one praises with care
meaning.hi: जैसे आदर से स्तुति करता है

meaning.en: a rich man, out of desire for wealth
meaning.hi: धनवान की, धन की इच्छा से

meaning.en: if one so praised the maker of the universe
who would not be freed from bondage?
in the presence of the sun, the world
acts entirely by itself
meaning.hi: अपने आप ही चेष्टा करता है

meaning.en: so, in my presence alone
meaning.hi: वैसे ही मेरी सन्निधि में ही

meaning.en: the whole world acts
as silver in mother-of-pearl
is imagined through illusion, so too
meaning.hi: माया से कल्पित है, वैसे ही

meaning.en: the world from the cosmic intellect onward, made of illusion
is in me alone
in an outcaste's body, in animals, in unmoving things
meaning.hi: चाण्डाल के शरीर में, पशु आदि में, स्थावर में

meaning.en: in the body of a knower of the highest reality
and in others placed in ranks of higher and lower
meaning.hi: और ऊँच-नीच क्रम में स्थित अन्यों में

meaning.en: I am not so, in a ranked way
even for one whose confusion of directions is gone
meaning.hi: जिसका दिशा-भ्रम नष्ट हो गया, उसे भी

meaning.en: the direction appears as before
so the world destroyed by knowledge
meaning.hi: वैसे ही ज्ञान से नष्ट जगत

meaning.en: appears to me, but it is not
meaning.hi: मुझे दिखता है, पर वह है नहीं

meaning.en: not the body, not the senses or breath
meaning.hi: न देह, न इन्द्रिय और प्राण

meaning.en: not mind, intellect or ego

words.sanskrit: na chittam na eva maya cha

meaning.en: not memory, nor illusion
nor the world beginning with space

words.sanskrit: na karta na eva bhokta cha

meaning.en: not the doer, nor the enjoyer
nor the one who makes others enjoy

words.sanskrit: kevalam chit sat ananda brahma eva aham

meaning.en: I am only the highest reality: awareness, being, joy
meaning.hi: मैं केवल चित्-सत्-आनन्द ब्रह्म ही हूँ

meaning.en: Janardana, a name of Vishnu
only because of the water's movement
as the sun appears to tremble
so, only from the tie with the ego
meaning.hi: वैसे ही अहंकार के सम्बन्ध से ही

meaning.en: is the worldly wandering of the self
worldly life has the mind as its root
meaning.hi: संसार की जड़ चित्त ही है

meaning.en: one should purify it with effort
meaning.hi: उसे प्रयत्न से शुद्ध करना चाहिए

meaning.en: alas, in the greatness of the mind
what is this trust of yours?
where are the riches of kings?
where are the worlds of the Creator?
the old ones have passed; series of creations have gone
meaning.hi: पुराने चले गए, सृष्टियों की परम्परा बीत गई

words.sanskrit: kotayah brahmanam yatah bhupah nashtah paragavat

meaning.en: millions of Creators have gone; kings perished like dust
meaning.hi: करोड़ों ब्रह्मा गए, राजा धूल की तरह नष्ट हुए

meaning.en: and even that pride in spirituality
meaning.hi: और वह अध्यात्म का अभिमान भी

meaning.en: in a learned person comes from a demonic nature
meaning.hi: विद्वान में आसुरी स्वभाव से होता है

meaning.en: if even the learned is demonic
the vision of truth is fruitless
passion and the rest, as they arise
by the fire of discerning knowledge
are burnt right then
how could they sprout?
just as one who is very skilful
delights in spotting others' faults
meaning.hi: दूसरों के दोष देखने में रत

meaning.en: if one were equally skilful about one's own
meaning.hi: वैसे ही यदि अपने में निपुण हो

meaning.en: who would not be freed from bondage?
one who does not know the self and is not free
meaning.hi: आत्मा को न जानने वाला, अमुक्त

meaning.en: longs for a web of special powers
through substances, formulas, rites, timing and technique
meaning.hi: द्रव्य, मन्त्र, क्रिया, काल और युक्ति से

meaning.en: attains them, O lord of sages
this is not the concern of the self-knower
for the self-knower sees only the self
meaning.hi: क्योंकि आत्मज्ञ केवल आत्मा को देखता है

meaning.en: fully content in the self, through the self
does not run after ignorance
whatever states of the world there are
meaning.hi: संसार के जो भी भाव हैं

meaning.en: they know them to be made of ignorance
how then could the self-knower in them
having abandoned ignorance, sink?
substances, formulas, rites, timing and techniques
meaning.hi: द्रव्य, मन्त्र, क्रिया, काल और युक्तियाँ

meaning.en: give good powers
in reaching the state of the supreme self
not one of them helps
when all the reckoning of desire comes to rest
meaning.hi: सब इच्छाओं के हिसाब के शान्त होने पर

meaning.en: that is called the dawn of gaining the self
meaning.hi: वह आत्मलाभ का उदय कहलाता है

meaning.en: how could that one, in the desire for powers
meaning.hi: वह फिर सिद्धि की इच्छा में

meaning.en: be fit, being free of the restless mind?

words.sanskrit: atha ha ribhum bhagavantam nidaghah papraccha

meaning.en: then Nidagha asked the blessed Ribhu
meaning.hi: तब निदाघ ने भगवान ऋभु से पूछा

meaning.en: 'tell me the marks of liberation while living'
'so be it', he said
of the seven stages, those free while living are in four
meaning.hi: सात भूमियों में जीवन्मुक्त चार में हैं

meaning.en: the first stage is longing for the good
the second is inquiry; the third, thinning of the mind
the fourth is arrival at clarity; the fifth, non-attachment
the sixth is the fading of objects; the seventh, going beyond
the stage made of the sacred syllable Om
made of A, U, M and the half-measure
meaning.hi: अकार, उकार, मकार और अर्धमात्रा से बनी

words.sanskrit: sthula sukshma bija sakshi bhedena akaradayah chaturvidhah

meaning.en: A and the rest are fourfold as gross, subtle, seed and witness
meaning.hi: अ आदि स्थूल, सूक्ष्म, बीज, साक्षी भेद से चार प्रकार के

meaning.en: in the gross part of A is the waking self of waking
meaning.hi: अकार के स्थूल अंश में जाग्रत-विश्व

meaning.en: in its subtle part is the dreaming self
in its seed part, the deep-sleep self
in its witness part, the fourth
in the gross part of U, the waking self of dream
meaning.hi: उकार के स्थूल अंश में स्वप्न-विश्व

meaning.en: in the subtle part, the dreaming self
in the seed part, the sleeping self
in the witness part, the fourth
in the gross part of M, the waking self of deep sleep
meaning.hi: मकार के स्थूल अंश में सुषुप्त-विश्व

meaning.en: in the subtle part, the dreaming self
in the seed part, the sleeping self
in the witness part, the fourth
in the gross part of the half-measure, the waking self of the fourth
meaning.hi: अर्धमात्रा के स्थूल अंश में तुरीय-विश्व

words.sanskrit: sukshmamshe tat taijasah bijamshe tat prajnah

meaning.en: in the subtle part, the dreaming self; in the seed part, the sleeping self
meaning.hi: सूक्ष्म अंश में तैजस, बीज अंश में प्राज्ञ

meaning.en: in the witness part, the fourth of the fourth
the fourth-parts of A
are the first, second and third stages
the fourth-part of U is the fourth stage
meaning.hi: उकार का तुरीय अंश चौथी भूमिका

meaning.en: the fourth-part of M, the fifth
the fourth-part of the half-measure, the sixth
what lies beyond that is the seventh
one who moves in the three stages is a seeker of freedom
meaning.hi: तीन भूमियों में विचरने वाला मुमुक्षु होता है

meaning.en: one who dwells in the fourth is a knower of the highest reality
meaning.hi: चौथी भूमि में विचरने वाला ब्रह्मवित् होता है

meaning.en: in the fifth, an excellent knower
in the sixth, a more excellent knower

words.sanskrit: saptama bhumyam viharan brahmavid varishthah bhavati

meaning.en: one in the seventh stage is the best knower of the highest reality
meaning.hi: सातवीं भूमि में विचरने वाला ब्रह्मविद्वरिष्ठ होता है

meaning.en: on this there are these verses

words.sanskrit: jnana bhumih shubhechha syat prathama samudirita

meaning.en: the first ground of knowledge is said to be the longing for the good
meaning.hi: ज्ञान की पहली भूमि शुभेच्छा कही गई है

meaning.en: the second is inquiry, the third the thinning of the mind
the fourth is the arrival at clarity
then the one named non-attachment
the sixth is the fading of objects
the seventh is known as going beyond
why do I remain a fool?
meaning.hi: मैं मूढ़ ही क्यों बैठा हूँ?

meaning.en: I shall be looked upon by scriptures and good people
meaning.hi: मैं शास्त्र और सज्जनों द्वारा देखा जाऊँ

meaning.en: such a wish, full of dispassion
is called the longing for the good by the wise
contact with scriptures and good people
along with the practice of dispassion
the engagement in good conduct that follows
that is called inquiry
through inquiry and the longing for the good
the passion for sense objects
where that becomes thin
meaning.hi: जहाँ वह पतला हो जाता है

meaning.en: that is called the thinning of the mind
through practising the three stages
by the power of the mind's turning away from objects
meaning.hi: चित्त में विषय-विरति के बल से

meaning.en: when it rests in the pure self of clarity
meaning.hi: शुद्ध सत्त्वात्मा में स्थित होने पर

meaning.en: that is called the arrival at clarity
from practising the four conditions
that whose fruit is freedom from clinging
with the wonder of firmly rooted clarity
meaning.hi: गहरे जमे सत्त्व के चमत्कार वाली

meaning.en: is declared the stage named non-attachment
meaning.hi: असंसक्ति नाम वाली कही गई है

meaning.en: from practising the five stages
through intense delight in one's own self
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा में गहरे रमण से

meaning.en: of inner and outer objects
through their no longer registering
only after long prompting by others
meaning.hi: दूसरों के प्रयोग से बहुत देर में

meaning.en: coming to awareness through that prompting
the one named the fading of objects
is the sixth stage
from long practice of the six stages
meaning.hi: छह भूमिकाओं के लम्बे अभ्यास से

meaning.en: through no longer perceiving difference
the being established solely in one's own nature
know that as the state that goes beyond
the three beginning with the longing for the good
are held to join difference and non-difference
meaning.hi: भेद-अभेद से युक्त मानी गई हैं

meaning.en: one knows this rightly through the intellect
meaning.hi: बुद्धि से इसे ठीक-ठीक जानता है

meaning.en: and the world is seen as in waking
meaning.hi: संसार जाग्रत की तरह दिखता है

meaning.en: when non-duality becomes steady
and duality has calmed down
through right practice in the fourth stage
they see the world as a dream
a torn shred of autumn cloud
meaning.hi: शरद के बादल का फटा टुकड़ा

meaning.en: melts away into dissolution
only clarity remains
Nidagha, make this firm
having climbed to the fifth stage
which is named the state of deep sleep
with all particular aspects quieted
remains in pure oneness
meaning.hi: केवल अद्वैत में स्थित रहता है

meaning.en: always turned inward
even while engaged in outward activity
meaning.hi: बाहरी वृत्ति में लगे रहकर भी

meaning.en: being always deeply at rest
appears as if sleepy
practising in this stage
meaning.hi: इस भूमि में अभ्यास करते हुए

meaning.en: thoroughly free of old tendencies
the seventh, called deep sleep
the ancient one, reached in due order

words.sanskrit: yatra na asat na sat rupah

meaning.en: where one is neither non-being nor being
neither 'I' nor 'not I'
simply, with thinking worn away
remains in oneness, utterly fearless
meaning.hi: अद्वैत में अत्यन्त निर्भय रहता है

meaning.en: empty within, empty without
like an empty pot in space
meaning.hi: आकाश में खाली घड़े की तरह

meaning.en: full within, full without
like a full pot in the ocean
meaning.hi: समुद्र में भरे घड़े की तरह

meaning.en: do not be the one who is grasped
nor be the one who grasps
letting go of all imagining
become that which remains
meaning.hi: जो शेष है, तन्मय हो जाओ

meaning.en: the seer, the seeing and the seen
giving up, together with old tendencies
the first flash of seeing
worship the self alone
for whom this stays as it is
meaning.hi: जिसके लिए यह जैसा है वैसा रहता है

meaning.en: even while dealing with it
has set, and only a still sky remains
meaning.hi: अस्त हो गया, ठहरा आकाश बचा

meaning.en: that one is called free while living
neither rises nor sets
meaning.hi: न उदय होती, न अस्त होती

meaning.en: the light of the mind in pleasure and pain
whose state accords with whatever comes
that one is called free while living
who is awake while resting in deep sleep
meaning.hi: जो सुषुप्ति में स्थित होकर जागता है

meaning.en: for whom waking does not exist
whose knowing is free of old tendencies
that one is called free while living
of liking, dislike, fear and the rest
even while acting in keeping with them
who within is unclouded like space
meaning.hi: जो भीतर आकाश की तरह अनाच्छन्न है

meaning.en: that one is called free while living
who has no sense of 'I am the doer'
whose understanding is not stained
whether acting or not acting
meaning.hi: करते हुए या न करते हुए

meaning.en: that one is called free while living
from whom the world is not disturbed
and who is not disturbed by the world
meaning.hi: और जो लोक से उद्विग्न नहीं होता

meaning.en: released from elation, resentment and fear
that one is called free while living
who, among the whole net of affairs
though engaged in dealings, stays cool
whole in himself, as if in others' affairs
meaning.hi: मानो दूसरों के मामलों में, पूर्णात्मा

meaning.en: that one is called free while living
when one gives up all desires
meaning.hi: जब सारी कामनाएँ छोड़ देता है

meaning.en: lodged in the mind, O sage
content in me, the self of all
that one is called free while living
in pure awareness free of any object to be known
meaning.hi: विषय से रहित केवल चेतना में

meaning.en: in the supremely purifying state
with an unstirred mind, at rest
that one is called free while living
this world, I, he, this one
the whole mass of visible things is unreal
in whose mind it does not flicker
meaning.hi: जिसके चित्त में स्फुरित नहीं होता

meaning.en: that one is called free while living
in the highest reality that is real, steady, vast
full and free of objects
entering quickly by the path of teacher and scripture
meaning.hi: आचार्य और शास्त्र के मार्ग से जल्दी प्रवेश करके

meaning.en: be steady
Shiva is the teacher, Shiva is the Veda
meaning.hi: शिव गुरु है, शिव वेद है

meaning.en: Shiva is God, Shiva is the Lord
meaning.hi: शिव देव है, शिव प्रभु है

meaning.en: I am Shiva, all is Shiva
meaning.hi: मैं शिव हूँ, सब शिव है

meaning.en: nothing whatever is other than Shiva
meaning.hi: शिव से अन्य कुछ भी नहीं

meaning.en: the steady one, having known that alone
the seeker of the highest reality should make it wisdom
should not dwell on many words
meaning.hi: बहुत शब्दों का चिन्तन न करे

meaning.en: for that only wearies the voice
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह वाणी की थकान ही है

meaning.en: Shuka was freed, and Vamadeva too was freed
meaning.hi: शुक मुक्त हुए, वामदेव भी मुक्त हुए

meaning.en: apart from these two, none attain freedom
meaning.hi: इन दोनों के बिना मुक्ति पाने वाले नहीं

meaning.en: the wise who follow Shuka's path
meaning.hi: जो धीर शुक-मार्ग का अनुसरण करते हैं

words.sanskrit: sadyah muktah te bhavanti iha loke

meaning.en: become free at once, here in this world
meaning.hi: वे इसी लोक में तुरन्त मुक्त होते हैं

meaning.en: those who always follow Vamadeva
meaning.hi: जो सदा वामदेव का अनुसरण करते हैं

meaning.en: dying and being born again and again

words.sanskrit: te vai loke krama muktah bhavanti

meaning.en: they become free step by step in the world
meaning.hi: वे संसार में क्रममुक्त होते हैं

meaning.en: through yoga, discerning knowledge and actions filled with clarity
meaning.hi: योग, सांख्य और सत्त्वयुक्त कर्मों से

meaning.en: Shuka and Vamadeva
are two paths made by the gods
meaning.hi: देवताओं द्वारा बनाए दो मार्ग हैं

meaning.en: Shuka's is called the way of the bird
meaning.hi: शुक का मार्ग विहंगम कहा गया है

meaning.en: Vamadeva's is the way of the ant
by setting aside what is not that
meaning.hi: जो वह नहीं, उसके निषेध के रूप से

meaning.en: or directly by positive teaching
by inquiry into the great sayings
by the absorption of discerning knowledge and yoga
meaning.hi: सांख्य और योग की समाधि से

meaning.en: having known the form of one's own self
through absorption with clear understanding
the stainless, by Shuka's path
go to the highest state
restraint and the rest, postures and effort
through forceful practice again and again
arising from a great many obstacles
here, through the pull of powers like becoming tiny
meaning.hi: यहाँ अणिमा आदि के वश से

meaning.en: not having fully obtained the fruit
meaning.hi: फल को ठीक से न पाकर भी

meaning.en: being born again in a noble family
carried again by the old impressions alone
takes up the practice of yoga once more
through practice over many births
by the path of Vamadeva
that one too attains freedom
that highest state of Vishnu
both of these paths
lead to the highest reality and are auspicious

words.sanskrit: sadyah mukti pradah cha ekah krama mukti pradah parah

meaning.en: one gives freedom at once, the other by stages
meaning.hi: एक सद्योमुक्ति देने वाला, दूसरा क्रममुक्ति देने वाला

words.sanskrit: atra kah mohah kah shokah ekatvam anupashyatah

meaning.en: what confusion, what grief, for one who sees oneness?
meaning.hi: एकत्व देखने वाले को यहाँ कैसा मोह, कैसा शोक?

meaning.en: one whose understanding reaches direct experience
meaning.hi: जिसकी बुद्धि अनुभव तक पहुँचती है

meaning.en: and operates in reality
all who come within that one's sight
meaning.hi: जो सब उसकी दृष्टि में आते हैं

meaning.en: are freed from all wrongdoing
meaning.hi: सब पापों से छूट जाते हैं

meaning.en: all that move in the sky and on the earth
meaning.hi: आकाश और धरती पर चलने वाले सभी

meaning.en: who come within the sight of a knower of the highest reality
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मज्ञानी की दृष्टि में आने वाले

meaning.en: are freed at once
meaning.hi: तुरन्त ही मुक्त हो जाते हैं

meaning.en: from wrongs gathered over millions of births
meaning.hi: करोड़ों जन्मों में कमाए पापों से

words.sanskrit: atha ha enam ribhum bhagavantam nidaghah papraccha

meaning.en: then Nidagha asked the blessed Ribhu
meaning.hi: तब निदाघ ने भगवान ऋभु से पूछा

meaning.en: 'teach me the method of yoga practice'

words.sanskrit: pancha bhuta atmakah dehah pancha mandala puritah

meaning.en: the body is made of five elements and filled with five regions
meaning.hi: देह पञ्चभूतात्मक है, पाँच मण्डलों से भरी

words.sanskrit: kathinyam prithivim ekam paniyam tat drava akriti

meaning.en: hardness is earth; water is its fluid form
meaning.hi: कठोरता पृथ्वी है, जल उसका द्रव रूप

meaning.en: what kindles is fire
movement is the mark of air
space, by its clear nature, pervades all
this should be known by one who wants yoga
meaning.hi: योग चाहने वाले को जानना चाहिए

words.sanskrit: shat shatani adhikani atra sahasrani ekavimshatih

meaning.en: twenty-one thousand and six hundred
breaths going out in a day and night
by the striking of the air region
when the earth region wears down
wrinkles come to embodied beings
likewise, when the waters decline
meaning.hi: वैसे ही जल-समूह के घटने पर

meaning.en: the hair turns white by degrees
meaning.hi: बाल क्रम से सफ़ेद हो जाते हैं

meaning.en: when fire declines, hunger and glow are lost
meaning.hi: तेज के क्षय से भूख और कान्ति नष्ट होती है

meaning.en: when air declines, trembling
arises constantly
and when the last element is spent, one does not live
meaning.hi: और अन्तिम तत्त्व चुकने पर जीवित नहीं रहता

meaning.en: thus, through constant decline
life, the holding together of the elements
since it keeps flying upward
without rest, the great bird
that itself is uddiyana, the upward flight
the lock applied there is called a bandha
this uddiyana lock
is a lion to the elephant of death
meaning.hi: मृत्यु रूपी हाथी के लिए सिंह

meaning.en: its benefit comes through the body
its lock is hard to master
when the fire in the belly is stirred
meaning.hi: पेट में अग्नि के हिलने पर

meaning.en: sharp pain arises
it should not be done when hungry
nor by one with the urge of stool or urine
meaning.hi: न मल-मूत्र के वेग वाले द्वारा

meaning.en: food should be wholesome and moderate
meaning.hi: हितकर और सीमित भोजन करना चाहिए

meaning.en: a little at a time, many times
for the gentle, middling and strong in order
meaning.hi: मृदु, मध्यम और उत्तम साधकों के लिए क्रम से

meaning.en: sacred sound, absorption and force
absorption, sound and force are the kinds of yoga
meaning.hi: लय, मन्त्र और हठ योग हैं

meaning.en: yoga is endowed with eight limbs
meaning.hi: योग आठ अंगों से युक्त है

meaning.en: the restraints and the observances
and also posture
then the regulation of breath
and after that the drawing in of the senses
steady focus and meditation
and absorption is the eighth
non-harming, truthfulness, not stealing
self-restraint, compassion, straightforwardness
patience, steadiness, moderate eating
and purity: these are the ten restraints
meaning.hi: और शौच: ये दस यम हैं

meaning.en: austerity, contentment, faith
generosity, worship of the Lord
listening to the settled teachings
modesty, a firm mind, repetition of sacred words and vows
these are declared the observances
tenfold, O great-minded one
there are eleven postures
beginning with the wheel, O best of sages
the wheel, the lotus, the tortoise
the peacock and the rooster
the hero's pose and the auspicious-mark pose
the gracious pose and the lion's seat
the freed pose and the cow-face pose
named by the best knowers of yoga
meaning.hi: योग के श्रेष्ठ ज्ञाताओं ने कहा है

meaning.en: the left thigh on the right ankle
the right on the other one
one should place them, with the body straight
this is held to be the wheel posture
inhaling, and likewise holding
exhaling, and inhaling again
breath regulation is through one's own channels
therefore the channels are described
the body of all creatures
measures ninety-six finger-widths
within it, from the region of the anus
beyond two finger-widths
below the region of the genitals
at two finger-widths, is called the centre
meaning.hi: दो अंगुल पर मध्य कहलाता है

meaning.en: nine finger-widths above the genitals
is called the bulb of the channels
four finger-widths in height
four finger-widths in breadth
egg-shaped and enclosed
by fat, marrow, bone and blood
meaning.hi: चर्बी, मज्जा, हड्डी और रक्त से

meaning.en: right there is the wheel of channels
established with twelve spokes
by which the body is held
there dwells the coiled power
the aperture to the crown, which is Sushumna
she closes with her mouth
meaning.hi: वह मुख से ढके रहती है

meaning.en: Alambusa runs with Sushumna
and there lies the channel Kuhu
in the next pair of spokes
are Varuna and Yashasvini
on the spoke to the right of Sushumna
Pingala is placed, in order
in the spokes between them is Pusha
meaning.hi: उनके बीच के आरों में पूषा

meaning.en: and Payasvini is placed
on the spoke behind Sushumna
meaning.hi: सुषुम्ना के पीछे वाले आरे पर

meaning.en: is placed the channel Sarasvati
Shankhini and Gandhari
are placed in the next two
meaning.hi: उसके बाद के दो में स्थित

meaning.en: to the north of Sushumna
dwells the one called Ida
next is Hastijihva
then Vishvodari is placed
in clockwise order
the channels are in the spokes of the wheel
these twelve are there
carrying the twelve currents of air
the channels are arranged like a woven cloth
meaning.hi: नाड़ियाँ कपड़े की तरह सजी हैं

meaning.en: said to be of many colours
meaning.hi: अनेक रंगों वाली कही गई हैं

meaning.en: the place at the centre of the cloth
meaning.hi: कपड़े के बीच की जो जगह है

meaning.en: is called the navel wheel
there is the one called the support of sound
blazing, whose form is sound
the supreme opening and Sushumna
these four are filled as with jewels
always covered by the coiled power
the middle of the opening to the crown
in this way, in these channels
the ten airs move
thus the course of the channels and of the airs
meaning.hi: इस तरह नाड़ियों की और वायुओं की गति

meaning.en: having understood, the discerning one
with neck, head and body in line
meaning.hi: गर्दन, सिर और शरीर एक सीध में

meaning.en: with the mouth closed, perfectly still
at the tip of the nose and in the middle of the heart
meaning.hi: नाक की नोक पर और हृदय के बीच

meaning.en: in the centre of the point of light, the fourth
one should see the flowing nectar
with both eyes, deeply collected
meaning.hi: दोनों आँखों से, अच्छी तरह एकाग्र

meaning.en: drawing in the downward current like a closing bud
meaning.hi: अपान को कली की तरह समेटकर

meaning.en: and pulling the anus upward
raising it with the syllable Om
one should turn it back with the seed-sound of Shri
one should meditate on one's self and on Shri
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा और श्री का ध्यान करे

meaning.en: and on the flooding of nectar
this is the cheating of time
they call it the foremost of all
a task conceived by the mind
is accomplished by that mind
meaning.hi: मन से ही सिद्ध होता है

meaning.en: from fire kindled in water
branches and shoots spring up
the world's saying proves not so
meaning.hi: संसार का वचन वैसा नहीं रहता

meaning.en: the ordinary course of action is reversed
holding the vital drop in its path
kindling the fire in the waters of life
drying up the water
by that the body becomes firm
with the anus and perineum joined
contracts them at one time
meaning.hi: एक ही समय में सिकोड़ता है

meaning.en: making the downward current rise
should join it with the balancing current
meditate on one's self and on Shri
meaning.hi: अपनी आत्मा और श्री का ध्यान करे

meaning.en: then on the flooding of nectar
one should begin the yoga of strength
through the central doorway
one should contemplate for the upward movement
through the right union of prana and apana
meaning.hi: प्राण और अपान के सुयोग से

meaning.en: this is the finest yoga in the body
meaning.hi: यह शरीर में श्रेष्ठ योग है

meaning.en: which lights up the path to attainment
just as a dam placed across
holds back the flow of a stream
so that which is set within the body
should always be understood by yogis
of all the channels
this lock is declared
by the grace of this lock
the divine becomes clearly manifest
thus the lock at the meeting of four ways
blocks three paths
opening one path
by which the perfected ones arrive
making the upward current rise
swiftly, together with the incoming breath
this lock of all the channels
moves upward, holding them in
this is the sealed-casket practice
it is also regarded as the root lock
meaning.hi: इसे मूलबन्ध भी माना गया है

meaning.en: by this alone the three locks
are perfected through steady practice
day and night without a break
in every watch, whenever possible
by this steady practice
the breath becomes mastered
when the breath is mastered
the fire grows daily in the body
meaning.hi: शरीर में अग्नि रोज़ बढ़ती है

meaning.en: and as the fire grows
food and the like are digested with ease
meaning.hi: अन्न आदि सुख से पचता है

meaning.en: through the full digestion of food
the nourishing essence increases
as the essence keeps increasing
the tissues of the body grow as well
through the growth of the tissues
an awakening arises in the body
all wrongs are burnt away
gathered over millions of births
situated between the anus and the genitals
meaning.hi: गुदा और जननांग के बीच स्थित

meaning.en: the root support, a triangle
the place of Shiva in the form of a point
it is radiant
where the one named Kundalini
the supreme power, is established
from whom the breath arises
from whom the fire grows
from whom the vital point is born
from whom the inner sound grows
from whom the swan of the breath arises
from whom the mind arises
the six wheels beginning with the root support
are called the seats of Shakti
meaning.hi: शक्ति के स्थान कहे गए हैं

meaning.en: from above the throat to the crown
meaning.hi: गले के ऊपर से सिर के शिखर तक

meaning.en: is called the seat of Shiva
the body is the support of the channels
the channels are the support of the breath
the breath is the dwelling of the living self
the living self is the support of the swan
the swan is the seat of Shakti
and so is this world of moving and unmoving things
free of wavering, with a serene self
one should practise the regulation of breath
even while firmly holding the three locks
meaning.hi: तीनों बन्धों में अच्छी तरह स्थित होकर भी

meaning.en: the goal, its signs and its source
one should always draw out what is to be known
with a mind aimed at the truth
meaning.hi: सत्य पर निशाना साधे मन से

meaning.en: the out-breath and the in-breath
one should still in the middle of the retention
in the supreme goal as it comes into view
resting oneself in the highest reality
every outer object
is called breathing out
breathing in is the knowledge of the scriptures
holding is one's own inner nature
if one's mind is trained in this way
meaning.hi: यदि इस तरह अभ्यस्त चित्त हो

meaning.en: that one is freed, without doubt
meaning.hi: वह मुक्त है, इसमें सन्देह नहीं

meaning.en: raising it by holding the breath
one should fill by holding the breath
with the vessel of held breath, fill and seal the vessel
meaning.hi: कुम्भ से कुम्भ को कुम्भित करे

meaning.en: within it is the supreme Shiva
then once more one should seal it
firmly, with the throat lock
enclosing the movement of the airs
holding the in-breath and the retention
with both hands evenly on the ground
and both feet evenly placed
by the method of piercing
the fourfold seat, with the breath
one should strike the great Meru, the spine
at the mouth of the air, again and again
drawing in through both nostrils
the breath quickly throbs
from the joining of moon, sun and fire
meaning.hi: सोम, सूर्य और अग्नि के सम्बन्ध से

meaning.en: one should know it leads to deathlessness
the gods dwelling within Meru
meaning.hi: मेरु के बीच रहने वाले देवता

meaning.en: are stirred when Meru is shaken
meaning.hi: मेरु के हिलने से हिलते हैं

meaning.en: first, quickly, there arises
the piercing of the knot of Brahma
having then pierced the knot of Brahma
one breaks through the knot of Vishnu
having then pierced the knot of Vishnu
one breaks through the knot of Rudra
having then pierced the knot of Rudra
and cut away the stain of delusion
through impressions from many births
and the grace of teacher and God
meaning.hi: गुरु और देव की कृपा से

meaning.en: then, through yoga practice, the piercing
takes place for that yogi
between Ida and Pingala
in the region of the central channel
through the special seals and locks
one should make the breath rise upward
the short sound burns away wrongdoing
the long sound grants liberation
the swelling or the prolonged sound
by sounding it in three measures
unbroken like a stream of oil
meaning.hi: तेल की धार की तरह अटूट

meaning.en: like the long ringing of a bell
meaning.hi: घण्टे की लम्बी ध्वनि की तरह

meaning.en: the unspeakable tip of Om
whoever knows it truly knows the Veda
meaning.hi: जो उसे जानता है वह वेदवित् है

words.sanskrit: hrasvam bindu gatam dirgham brahmarandhra gatam plutam

meaning.en: the short goes to the point of light, the long to the crown, the prolonged beyond
meaning.hi: ह्रस्व बिन्दु तक, दीर्घ ब्रह्मरन्ध्र तक, प्लुत आगे

words.sanskrit: dvadashanta gatam mantram prasadam mantra siddhaye

meaning.en: reaching twelve finger-widths beyond, the mantra brings the grace of success
meaning.hi: द्वादशान्त तक जाने वाला मन्त्र सिद्धि का प्रसाद देता है

meaning.en: this removes every obstacle
meaning.hi: यह सारे विघ्न हरने वाला है

meaning.en: this Om destroys every fault
the beginning and the vessel
then familiarity
and completion: thus are declared
its four stages
arising from the three causes
letting go of outward action
one takes up inner action
that is called the beginning
the breath, piercing from behind
meaning.hi: वायु पीछे से वेध करती हुई

meaning.en: fills and becomes steady
where it rests, that is declared
meaning.hi: जहाँ टिकती है, वह कही गई

meaning.en: by the wise the stage of the vessel
meaning.hi: ज्ञानियों द्वारा घट नाम की भूमिका

words.sanskrit: na sajivah na nirjivah kaye tishthati nishchalam

meaning.en: neither alive nor lifeless, one sits still in the body
meaning.hi: न सजीव न निर्जीव, शरीर में निश्चल रहता है

meaning.en: where the breath stands firm in the inner sky
meaning.hi: जहाँ वायु आकाश में स्थिर हो

meaning.en: where through the self, creation and dissolution
meaning.hi: जहाँ आत्मा से सृष्टि और लय

meaning.en: one who has reached freedom while living
practises yoga naturally
meaning.hi: सहज रूप से योग करता है

meaning.en: that is the stage of completion
whoever studies this Upanishad
meaning.hi: जो इस उपनिषद् का अध्ययन करता है

words.sanskrit: sah agni putah bhavati sah vayu putah bhavati

meaning.en: is purified as by fire, purified as by wind
meaning.hi: वह अग्नि से पवित्र, वायु से पवित्र होता है

words.sanskrit: surapanat putah bhavati svarna steyat putah bhavati

meaning.en: is purified from drinking liquor and from stealing gold
meaning.hi: मदिरापान और स्वर्ण-चोरी से शुद्ध होता है

meaning.en: becomes free while living
this has been declared by a Vedic verse
meaning.hi: यह ऋचा द्वारा कहा गया है

words.sanskrit: tat vishnoh paramam padam sada pashyanti surayah

meaning.en: the wise always see that highest step of Vishnu
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी विष्णु के उस परम पद को सदा देखते हैं

meaning.en: spread like an eye across the sky
meaning.hi: आकाश में आँख की तरह फैला

meaning.en: the wakeful sages, full of praise, set it alight
meaning.hi: जागे हुए, स्तुति करने वाले ऋषि उसे प्रज्वलित करते हैं

meaning.en: such is the Upanishad
